description: One job-scoped communication audit: proposal DMs, Job DMs, and channels for ONE job with complete thread bodies available via opentrain_get_message_thread, sender display name/role/employer-organization membership, opaque attachment metadata (attachments[].attachmentId — never a signed URL; retrieve bytes with opentrain_get_message_attachment), active/ended contract context, and ORGANIZATION-level needsEmployerReply — a reply from ANY employer teammate resolves a lane; worker-only threads stay open; a worker follow-up after a teammate reply reopens it. Filters: since/until/search/senderUserId/hasAttachments/contextType/includeThreads; cursor-paged. Requires messages:read scope and employer access to the job. Read-only: never creates or mutates conversations.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (nextCursor).

hasAttachments.description: true returns only messages carrying attachments.

includeThreads.description: false restricts to top-level messages (thread replies excluded). Default true.

jobId.description: Job id to audit (employer access required).

senderUserId.description: Filter to one sender user id.

name: opentrain_audit_job_messages
